# Let me also check invitees to see who appears most overall
invitees_count = {}
for line in lines[1:]:
    fields = line.split('\t')
    if len(fields) > 4:
        invitees = fields[4].split('; ')
        for inv in invitees:
            inv = inv.strip()
            if inv:

sorted_inv = sorted(invitees_count.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])

# Find the max event ID to determine the next one

    fields = line.split('\t')
    if fields:
        try:
            eid = int(fields[0])
            if eid > max_id:
                max_id = eid
        except ValueError:
            pass

print(f"Max event ID: {max_id}")
print(f"Next event ID: {max_id + 1}")

# Check the header fields
print(f"Header fields: {header.split(chr(9))}")

# Look at a sample event to understand the format
sample = lines[1].split('\t')

# New event details

title = "Onboarding Equipment Status Review"
date = "2026-09-07"
time = "14:00"
organizer = "Mia Chen"

# Append the new event to the file

result = await write_file("./uploads/calendar.txt", updated_content)
print(result)

# Verify the new event was added correctly
